_comment: Controls which PCO custom fields are mirrored into pco.field_data. Fields with "include": false are never written to the database. Field DEFINITIONS (names/types) are always mirrored — only VALUES are gated. Setting a field to true is a deliberate act: once values are copied they also live in every database backup.

_decisions.elderStaffRelation: Fields 658689-658692 (Elder/Staff Relation Preference 01-04) are EXCLUDED. Treated as a pastoral confidence rather than analytics data. Revisit with eldership if follow-up routing ever needs it.
_decisions.custom2Tab: Fields 953705-957521 are INCLUDED by explicit decision, though several duplicate core person columns. Note that PRIMARY ADDRESS places home addresses in the analytics database and its backups — factor this into dashboard access control.
